data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Nedda was an epithet for the goddess Demeter. The name means 'comforter' or 'solace', reflecting Demeter's role as a nurturing and protective deity. In Christianity, Nedda can be seen as a symbol of consolation and hope. The name Nedda carries the meaning “Comforter, Solace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nedda usually hope their child will grow to embody comforter, solace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
